import java.util.Scanner;

public class mainF {
    public static Scanner enter = new Scanner(System.in);
    public static long mod = 998244353;
    public static long cnk[][] = new long[(int) 2e3 + 1][(int) 2e3 + 1];
    public static long fact[] = new long[2 * (int) 2e3 + 1];
    public static long invFact[] = new long[2 * (int) 2e3 + 1];
    public static long deg_2[] = new long[(int) 2e3 + 1];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Precompute factorials and powers of 2
        fact[0] = 1;
        deg_2[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < fact.length; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < deg_2.length; i++) {
            deg_2[i] = deg_2[i - 1] * 2 % mod;
        }
        // Precompute modular inverses of factorials (all indices)
        invFact[fact.length - 1] = bin_pow(fact[fact.length - 1], mod - 2, mod);
        for (int i = fact.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
        }
        // Precompute binomial coefficients using factorials
        for (int i = 0; i < cnk.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                cnk[j][i] = fact[i] * invFact[j] % mod * invFact[i - j] % mod;
            }
        }
        // Read input
        int n = enter.nextInt();
        int k = enter.nextInt();
        long l = enter.nextLong() % mod;
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = k; i <= n; i++) {
            long tmp = 0;
            for (int s = 0, c = 1; s <= n - i; s++, c = -c) {
                long a = cnk[s][n - i] * deg_2[s] % mod;
                a = a * fact[s + i] % mod;
                a = a * fact[s + i] % mod;
                a = a * invFact[2 * (s + i) + 1] % mod;
                tmp = (tmp + a * c) % mod;
            }
            long b = tmp * deg_2[i] % mod;
            b = b * cnk[i][n] % mod;
            ans = (ans + b) % mod;
        }
        ans = ans * l % mod;
        System.out.println((ans + mod) % mod);
    }

    public static long bin_pow(long a, long b, long mod) {
        long ans = 1;
        while (b != 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ans = ans * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
